faq.title: Jaguar XJ AJ-V6 FAQs
faq.description: Answers about pricing, warranty, outputs and fitting for the Jaguar XJ AJ-V6 petrol engine.

faqs.q: How much does a Jaguar XJ AJ-V6 engine replacement cost?
faqs.a: It depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine and whether we fit it. Send your registration for an itemised written quote covering parts and labour.

faqs.q: Do your AJ-V6 engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: What power does the XJ6's AJ-V6 produce?
faqs.a: XJ6 specifications list 175kW, or 238hp, with 293Nm of torque. The 230hp figure some listings mention aligns more closely with the X-Type version, so we confirm the source first.

faqs.q: Did the 1996 Jaguar XJ use the AJ-V6?
faqs.a: No. The 1996 XJ used straight-six and V12 engines. The AJ-V6 arrived in the XJ6 with the X350 from 2003, so we confirm your engine code using the VIN.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XJ AJ-V6 engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include coil failures, thermostat housing and coolant leaks, timing chain noise and oil leaks. Symptoms can overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair or replacement decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver an AJ-V6 to my garage?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK, to homes or independent garages. We confirm compatibility before dispatch and explain warranty conditions for third-party fitting.

faqs.q: What does your XJ6 supply and fit service include?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete any setup and road test your XJ6. Timescales are confirmed when we quote.

workshopIntro.title: Making a Sensible Choice About Your AJ-V6
workshopIntro.description: Start with a proper diagnosis. Coil failures, thermostat housing leaks and vacuum leaks are often fixable without removing the engine. If overheating or coolant contamination has caused internal damage, compare the repair estimate with your XJ6's mileage, condition and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XJ AJ-V6 engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its history and whether fitting is included. Labour forms a large part of the bill, so complete supply and fit quotes offer the fairest comparison between different suppliers.

When browsing AJ-V6 3.0 V6 petrol engine UK listings, ask which model the engine came from, since S-Type and X-Type units can differ in output and ancillaries. Confirm recorded mileage and any pre-sale checks too.

Warranty is worth checking as well. A Jaguar XJ AJ-V6 engine with warranty offers protection if a mechanical fault develops after fitting. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms before you order.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XJ AJ-V6 Engine Problems to Notice
engineProblems.description: These symptoms may suggest a fault, but diagnosis must confirm it.

cards.title: Coolant in the Oil
cards.description: Milky oil or unexplained coolant loss could point to a water pump, head gasket or other internal leak needing investigation.
cards.action: Stop driving and book a check.

cards.title: Misfire and Shaking
cards.description: A rough idle, shaking or flashing engine light may relate to ignition coils, spark plugs or injector faults.

cards.title: Thermostat Housing Leaks
cards.description: Coolant drips or a sweet smell near the top of the engine might indicate a cracked thermostat housing or hose.
cards.action: Request a cooling system pressure test.

cards.title: Timing Chain Noise
cards.description: A rattle at start-up or idle could suggest worn timing chain tensioners, guides or variable valve timing components.

cards.title: Oil Leaks Visible
cards.description: Oil on the cam covers or beneath the car may come from tired gaskets, seals or the oil filter housing.
cards.action: Have the leak traced and assessed.

cards.title: Hesitation and Poor Economy
cards.description: Flat acceleration or rising fuel use could relate to vacuum leaks, sensor faults or a struggling fuel supply.

engineOverview.title: The 3.0 V6 Petrol Engine Behind the XJ6
paragraphs: The AJ-V6 is Jaguar's 2,967cc naturally aspirated V6 petrol engine, also listed as the AJ30. In the X350 and X358 XJ6 it was rated at 175kW, or 238hp, with 293Nm of torque, driving the rear wheels through a smooth six-speed automatic from 2003 to 2009.

The same engine family appears in the X-Type, where the 3.0 V6 was listed at 231hp. That may explain searches for a Jaguar XJ 3.0 V6 petrol engine 230hp, although XJ6 specifications show 238hp, so we always confirm the donor engine's origin.

A Jaguar XJ AJ-V6 engine 1996 search will not match, as the XJ of that year used straight-six and V12 engines. The AJ-V6 arrived with the aluminium X350 in 2003, and its camshafts are chain-driven, so there is no cambelt to replace.
